name: @inzamol/stackvet
description: StackVet Universal Project Health & Static Diagnostics Engine

scripts.build:all: npm run build:pypi && npm run build:npm && npm run build:vscode
scripts.self-check: cargo run --bin stackvet -- check . --strict && cargo run --bin stackvet -- doctor .
scripts.self-check:vscode: cargo run --bin stackvet -- check editors/vscode --strict && cargo run --bin stackvet -- doctor editors/vscode
scripts.self-check:all: npm run self-check && npm run self-check:vscode

author: Inzamul Hoque
